h1: Hop Inn Surin — a clean, great-value budget hotel in central Surin
intro: If you're in Surin and want a budget place with clean rooms, comfy beds and the market and City Pillar nearby — Hop Inn Surin is a 2-star Hop Inn chain hotel known for its same dependable standard rooms across every branch: clean, simple and genuinely functional. It has 79 rooms, opened in 2018, set on Poy Tang Ko Alley in Nai Mueang, a few minutes' walk from Wat Burapharam and the City Pillar Shrine, with free Wi-Fi and free parking. From approx. THB 650/night. Scored 9.3 from 126 reviews on Trip.com and 8.3 on Booking.com.

body.html: What makes Hop Inn a frequent pick across Thailand is consistency. It's a budget chain where every branch has the same standard room: clean, simple and genuinely functional, so you never have to guess what you'll get. The Surin branch opened in 2018 and has 79 rooms, and reviews agree the rooms are very clean, the beds comfortable, the AC cold and the staff friendly. A cleanliness score as high as 9.6 is the main reason guests come back when passing through Surin.

Rooms come in two simple types: Standard Twin (two single beds) and Standard Double (one large bed). Every room is 20 sqm with AC, a TV, a fridge, a work desk, an en-suite bathroom and the basics covered. They aren't fancy, but everything is new, clean and well kept, which is exactly what guests want at this price. Because they're built for a good night's sleep, business travellers and road-trippers can rest comfortably without paying much.
"Excellent, clean and functional with friendly staff. Cold AC, comfy bed, close to the market and the City Pillar so you can walk out for dinner. Best value in town."

One thing to know before booking: Hop Inn is a rooms-only hotel. There's no breakfast, no restaurant, and no pool or spa, in line with the budget-chain model. That's rarely a problem at this location, though, because the hotel is surrounded by restaurants, cafés and the city market, all within easy walking distance. Free Wi-Fi is in every room, and there's free first-come, first-served parking that road-trippers appreciate.

Location is this branch's strong suit. Set on Poy Tang Ko Alley in Nai Mueang, it's only about 200 m from Wat Burapharam, roughly 400 m from the Surin City Pillar Shrine, and an easy walk to the old town and city market. It's about 1.3 km from Surin Railway Station and 2.8 km from the Surin Night Bazaar. That makes it ideal if you arrive by train or want to explore the city on foot without a car. A location score of 9.3 and a service score of 9.5 show both the spot and the staff win guests over.

Honestly, Hop Inn Surin suits anyone who wants a clean, safe, affordable room with a walkable city location — whether you're here for work, the elephant events, a merit-making trip, or just an overnight stop while driving through Surin. But if you expect breakfast, a pool or a boutique feel, this isn't it: it's a budget hotel focused on the room itself. The one recurring note in some reviews is that the shower pressure can feel a little low in some rooms, but otherwise there's barely a real complaint.

A tip from following the reviews here: book direct via the Hop Inn website or compare a few platforms first, since prices tend to move within a few hundred baht and booking ahead is sometimes cheaper. If you arrive by train, it's a short walk or motorbike-taxi ride from the station. And for a local dinner, just head to the city market or the eateries around the City Pillar — no car needed.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Hop Inn Surin

faq.q: Where is Hop Inn Surin, and what's nearby?
faq.a: The hotel is on Poy Tang Ko Alley in Nai Mueang, Mueang Surin, in the city centre. It's about 200 m from Wat Burapharam and roughly 400 m from the Surin City Pillar Shrine, with the city market an easy walk away. It's about 1.3 km from Surin Railway Station and 2.8 km from the Night Bazaar.

faq.q: How much does Hop Inn Surin cost, and what rooms are there?
faq.a: From approx. THB 650/night for a standard room. There are two types — Standard Twin (two single beds) and Standard Double (one large bed) — both 20 sqm. Advance-purchase rates can drop to around THB 600; always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Hop Inn Surin serve breakfast?
faq.a: No, there's no breakfast and no restaurant, as it's a rooms-only Hop Inn budget hotel. But the hotel is surrounded by the city market and local eateries within walking distance, so breakfast and dinner are easy to find.

faq.q: Are the rooms at Hop Inn Surin clean, and is it good value?
faq.a: This is the hotel's strong point. Most reviews praise very clean rooms, comfy beds and cold AC, with a cleanliness score as high as 9.6 and an overall 9.3 from 126 Trip.com reviews. At this price, it's the best value in the area.

faq.q: Does Hop Inn Surin have parking, and is it good for train travellers?
faq.a: Yes, there's free first-come, first-served parking for those driving in. And because it's only about 1.3 km from Surin Railway Station, it's a great choice for train travellers — a short walk or motorbike-taxi ride from the station.

faq.q: Who is Hop Inn Surin best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for budget travellers who want a clean, safe room with a walkable city location — for work, the elephant events, a merit-making trip, or an overnight stop while passing through. If you want breakfast, a pool or a boutique feel, consider another type of stay in town.
